name: digital-sponsor
description: AI-powered AA literature companion for those who cannot access traditional sponsorship
author: Digital Sponsor Contributors

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend && npm run test:ai
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:ai
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:frontend -- --fix && npm run lint:backend -- --fix && cd ai && black .
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:ai"
scripts.setup:dev: npm run install:all && npm run setup:env && npm run setup:db
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install && cd ../ai && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup:env: cp .env.example .env && echo 'Please edit .env with your configuration'
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules frontend/node_modules backend/node_modules frontend/build backend/dist ai/__pycache__ ai/*.pyc
scripts.type-check: cd frontend && npm run type-check && cd ../backend && npm run type-check
scripts.security:audit: npm audit && cd frontend && npm audit && cd ../backend && npm audit
